title: I used AI to make a 2d point and click game engine.
author: Ok-Suspect-9855
selftext:
I always liked the Sierra games as a kid and saw there wasn't many these days. Instead of just building a game i thought why not build a game engine so I can create many games without code. It took 2 months but the game engine is basically ready.

The last step to finish this coming week, I trained ai models so players can have voice conversations with all the npcs in realtime and they can chat back in charachter. It will all run locally on pc, web or phone so no ongoing charges for players to chat.

Just posting to get used to marketing posts since I have to change from creation mode to marketing mode as i start releasing games.

comments.author: siendo64
comments.body:
Cool stuff, what’s the engine’s foundation? 

Also, posting to share learnings and progress is much preferred to marketing posts.

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: So its all web based but can ship to any device with wrappers. Just built it all from scratch uses a lot of video models (for animation), image models (for sprites), depth models (for sizing and animation), masking models (for layers), tts/stt models (for chachter speech), lipsync models (for facial animation) will post more as I go. I also invented a few new AI technologies to make it possible for the chahter to speak locally. Many lessons I learnt manually, things like AGS has built in but I wanted a fully customised . Happy to share if anyone has questions as I post more examples of the actual games.

replies.author: StunningGold8030
replies.body: Amazing, yeah please post samples of the characters talking and other features.

replies.author: Hot-Spare5735
replies.body:
The local AI NPC model is very cool. We have explored similar things for our games but we didn't want to have to pay for compute for the characters. Having it all local and free is pretty amazing.


I hope we see more of this tech in story based games. It might be a use of AI in games that people would be more accepting of.

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body:
Yeah, I don't pay to.have the AI in there. Currntly I'm using modified off the shelf one It's 100 megabytes and five megabytes for each character. Then I also invented new AI thats currently training (2 more weeks left) just for this will bring it down to 40mb/5mb and the second generation I anticipate 20mb/5mb. But even the current one 100mb is small enough for basically any browser or phone and has 400ms first token and 100 tokens per second. 

There is not as much hatred as people say its the creators that are being emotional not the users. When they have the users upset is badly implemented, for example I  have a live streaming ai charachter that runs 24/7 so i cant monitor it all the time everyone will try to get it to swear, say racist things its the nature of it. If you dont implement it properlly or you implement slop it will do dumb things then users will be upset but if you do it right people enjoy it.

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: potentailly after building and releasing some games with it.

comments.author: BrotherMoy
comments.body: Will your game engine have the ability to generate an entire 2D point and click game on the fly? Seems like it could be almost there

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: yes i have 70 senes in the one i using to learn it. Recreating quest for glory the whole game. My thought was if i can do that and police quest with modern graphics then i will catch any edge cases.

comments.author: khuzait_haircut
comments.body: Nice I did something similar too. Today you can totally make 2d games with AI.

comments.author: shadowlands-mage
comments.body: what you use to define where the character can walk  and on what to click ?

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body:
So I have somthing called a prop which is image or video that make the items charachter can click on it has logic like animate on certain conditions (box opens player opens and has key). 

For the walkable area I start with grok image model ask it to color in the areas where player can walk to make a mask then use other model like sam3, edge detectors and editors so i can manually edit it quickly.

replies.author: shadowlands-mage
replies.body: thx! but do you crate your own engine for that or use ready made engine?

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: All custom built, planing to make a lot of games starting the first one this week kind of x files/aliens/disclosure point and click game

comments.author: PhotojournalistBig53
comments.body: Quest for glory! One of my all time favorites! Spent many days outside those walls typing ”get dagger” ”throw dagger”

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: yeah i spent months playing and finishing every single one of the quest for glory and police quest series. I liked the typing to speak more than the clicking. i always wanted to be able to speak to them instead of clicking or typing though. With this one i am putting a local ai model so you can speak with each character and can have a conversation.

comments.author: flaminghotcola
comments.body: What service or software did you use to create this engine? Was it all purely vibe coded?

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: All vibe coded with Claude Code. I was senior software engineer for 10 years, there is no need for people to ever code or even use a keyboard anymore. I just use a speech to text i made and chat with it all day.
